Get Excel File from DEA Directory

Source: R/dea_io.R
get_dea_xlsx.Rd

Finds the Excel results file within a DEA directory's `Results_WU_*` subfolder, preferring the `DE_`-prefixed workbook that prolfquapp writes. Falls back to searching `dea_dir` itself when no such subfolder exists.

Usage

get_dea_xlsx(dea_dir)

Arguments

dea_dir

Path to DEA output directory

Value

Full path to the Excel file

Examples

dea_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "DEA_example")
results <- file.path(dea_dir, "Results_WU_example")
dir.create(results, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.create(file.path(results, c("DE_example.xlsx", "other.xlsx")))
#> [1] TRUE TRUE

basename(get_dea_xlsx(dea_dir))
#> Using: DE_example.xlsx
#> [1] "DE_example.xlsx"
